text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh no.
Did I just sigh out loud?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Please forget about it.
I'll be back in top shape in no time, so don't worry."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Umamusume who's going to be number one, remember?
There's no way something like this would tire me out. Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All you need to think about is making me win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, however, Daiwa Scarlet would
still let out a faint sigh without realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cause might lie in the schedule.
It looks like we'll need to review her upcoming race plan.
